database.orm_queries module

orm_queries.py Repeats a subset of the Part 2 SQL analysis using the SQLAlchemy ORM instead of handwritten SQL. Run directly (python orm_queries.py, with PGUSER/PGPASSWORD set) to print every answer.

database.orm_queries.orm_a1(session)[source]

What percentage of total acceptances come from each term found in the data?

Parameters:

session (sqlalchemy.orm.Session) – Active SQLAlchemy session.

Returns:

The formatted answer.

Return type:

str
